activities.summary: UAE onshore sourcing pass: strong dual trigger — live BGIOF fund NFO (2026-01-14 to 2026-02-13) and a 2025-08-01 CEO-Designate appointment. Onshore SCA licence is transitioning to the federal CMA from 2026-01-01 (Federal Decree-Law No. 32 of 2025) — a regulatory-change signal worth watching across all onshore UAE prospects, not unique to this firm. Next: confirm a direct contact route for Dwivedi before drafting outreach.

CORRECTION to the handover's premise. The handover named Barjeel Geojit as 'the one lead with a fund open for subscription right now'. That is stale: the BGIOF NFO window was 2026-01-14 to 2026-02-13 and closed seven months ago. Verified live on barjeel.ae 2026-09-22 - the homepage banner still reads 'now open for subscription' but the footer is (c) 2025, so that is leftover NFO copy. The defensible reading is that BGIOF is an OPEN-ENDED umbrella fund still accepting subscriptions, which is a different and weaker hook. Do NOT write 'I see your NFO is open' - it would be wrong and visibly so. The real hook is that they launched a UAE-domiciled USD umbrella fund with SEGREGATED SUB-FUNDS this year and are now operating it: NAV per sub-fund, subscriptions/redemptions and shareholder registry are exactly the fund-administration workload. Also captured a real published contact route (dubai@barjeel.ae, +971 4 3060 900) from their own site - generic, not guessed. Also confirmed they now describe themselves as a 'CMA Regulated Company', corroborating the SCA-to-CMA rename.

Drafted first-touch to Surendra Dwivedi (CEO-Designate) on the BGIOF umbrella/sub-fund fund-administration workload. No direct email/LinkedIn on file for Dwivedi, so the draft routes via the firm's published general inbox (dubai@barjeel.ae) as a fallback, Attn: Dwivedi. Does NOT claim the NFO is open (corrected per prior activity entry). Full draft with mailto link: outreach/2026-09-22-top-leads.md. Awaiting Andre's review before send.

Corrected a stale trigger. The record claimed a live NFO subscription window; it closed 2026-02-13, seven months ago. A trigger that has expired is worse than no trigger — it puts a wrong fact in the first sentence we say to a client.

Drafted a first-touch email to dubai@barjeel.ae, Attn: Surendra Dwivedi (CEO-Designate), on the BGIOF sub-fund administration load. ⚠ Reaches a shared inbox, not him directly. Draft held in outreach/2026-09-25-uae-batch.md. NOT SENT — Andre approves and sends.

description: Onshore UAE mainland financial intermediary (est. 2001, a JV between Sheikh Sultan Sooud Al Qasimi and India's Geojit Financial Services), offices in Dubai, Abu Dhabi and Sharjah, serving 50,000+ NRI investors. Holds an SCA licence for promotion/introduction services and full Investment Fund Management. Launched the Barjeel Geojit India Opportunities Fund (BGIOF), a UAE-domiciled USD-denominated umbrella fund with segregated sub-funds targeting India-focused equities; NFO subscription window 2026-01-14 to 2026-02-13. Surendra Dwivedi joined as CEO-Designate on 2025-08-01 (per LinkedIn/Facebook posts); founder-director K.V. Shamsudheen remains involved.

fit.reasoning: Fit 50/60: priority asset-manager/fund-manager segment (20) + UAE onshore (15) + third-party fund investors, 50,000+ retail NRI base (10) + SCA-regulated (5); multi-asset scored 0 since BGIOF is an India-equities umbrella fund, not evidence of cross-asset-class breadth. Trigger 20/25: the Barjeel Geojit India Opportunities Fund now runs as a live umbrella with segregated sub-funds, so NAV per sub-fund, subscriptions/redemptions and the shareholder registry are a daily operating load. ⚠ CORRECTED 2026-09-25: this clause previously described the NFO subscription window as live; it closed 2026-02-13 and quoting it would have been wrong in front of the client. Access 8/15: named CEO-Designate and founder-director identified. Total 83 — hot: a live fund launch with subscriptions open right now is as concrete a fund-administration hook as this pass found. Dwivedi's appointment date (2025-08-01) is search-confirmed via LinkedIn/Facebook posts but not cross-verified against a company filing; treat as reasonably reliable but confirm before using in outreach.
